title: The Static of New Lagos
author: Coral Ashgrove
blurb: Yara Nystrom, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
